paper.title_en: Memory-like effects and kinematics of trajectories in cyclotron motion
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the collective dynamics of a bundle of charged particles undergoing cyclotron motion in a uniform magnetic field when subjected to a short-duration electric pulse. Using the geometric framework based on the evolution of trajectory congruences, we analyze how the pulse affects the expansion, shear, and rotation of a small family of trajectories. We show that the geometric imprint persists after the pulse has vanished, manifesting as a memory of the transient perturbation. Unlike gravitational memory effects, this does not manifest itself in focusing behavior of the trajectories, and instead implies a restructuring of the shear component before and after the pulse. We offer direct analytic and regression-based arguments for the same.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文以轨迹同余的几何框架研究回旋运动中电场脉冲引起的记忆类效应，与引力记忆效应形成类比与对比，属于广义相对论基础中记忆效应主题的相关工作；解析论证与回归分析相结合，方法有一定严谨性，但主题更偏经典电动力学模拟，与引力物理核心关联较间接，故评分中等。
decision.title_zh: 回旋运动中的记忆类效应与轨迹运动学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究一束在均匀磁场中做回旋运动的带电粒子，在受到短时电脉冲作用时的集体动力学。利用基于轨迹同余演化的几何框架，我们分析了该脉冲如何影响一小族轨迹的膨胀、剪切与旋转。我们表明，几何印记在脉冲消失之后依然持续存在，表现为对瞬态扰动的记忆。与引力记忆效应不同，这种效应并不体现在轨迹的聚焦行为中，而是意味着脉冲前后剪切分量的重构。我们为此提供了直接的解析论证和基于回归的论证。
